verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents a live JetBrains connector (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm) and separately documents an interactive diff review workflow, but the evidence never describes how these combine — no detail on viewing diffs inside the JetBrains plugin or selecting/sharing code as context from the IDE. missing for 10: JetBrains-specific diff UI documentation, evidence of selecting code in-editor and sending it as context, independent/hands-on confirmation of the connector's behavior.
